case_title: SARAH RUBY ARMSTRONG VS. GLASS CEILING LLC

docket_entries.description: ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT.
ORDER TO DISMISS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: SYLVIA L. HUSING; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY ARMSTRONG, SARAH RUBY AS TO DEFENDANT GLASS CEILING LLC ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-07-2022 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $80) SERVED OCT-17-2022, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT GLASS CEILING LLC
REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM FILED BY PLAINTIFF ARMSTRONG, SARAH RUBY
DECLARATION RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM FILED BY PLAINTIFF ARMSTRONG, SARAH RUBY
ORDER RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM(PLANTIFF)**GRANTED**

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-07-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-12-2023 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SARAH RUBY ARMSTRONG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GLASS CEILING, REPRESENTED BY MAXINE ANDERSON, FOUNDER IS PRESENT. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $5,709.000 (INCLUDES COSTS) TO BE MADE IN 3 PAYMENTS OF $1,903.00 THROUGH ZELLE. 1ST PAYMENT DUE ON JANUARY 31, 2023, 2ND PAYMENT DUE ON FEBRUARY 28, 2023, AND FINAL PAYMENT DUE ON MARCH 31, 2023. NO APPEARANCE REQUIRED IF PAYMENTS ARE MADE AS AGREED, AND THE CASER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED AT THE NEXT HEARING. APPEARANCE ARE REQRUIED IF PAYMENTS ARE NOT RECEIVED AS AGREED TO AT WHICH TIME A COURT JUDGMENT WILL BE RENDERED FOR THE FULL AMOUNT OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
